## How to install / update

1. Download **SariSariPOS-v….zip** below (under *Assets*).
2. Right-click the zip → **Extract All…**
3. Open the extracted folder and double-click **Install Sari-Sari POS**.
   If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
4. Use the **Sari-Sari POS** icon on the Desktop.

Updating? Do the same steps. Your sales, products and utang records are kept.

## Paano i-install / i-update

1. I-download ang **SariSariPOS-v….zip** sa ibaba (sa *Assets*).
2. I-right-click ang zip → **Extract All…**
3. Buksan ang folder at i-double-click ang **Install Sari-Sari POS**.
   Kung may "Windows protected your PC", i-click ang **More info** → **Run anyway**.
4. Gamitin ang **Sari-Sari POS** icon sa Desktop.

Mag-a-update? Ganoon din ang gagawin. Hindi mabubura ang records mo.
